verdict.summary: NO_GO — the CENTRAL fiscal layer carries two confirmed P0 NF525 gap-free breaches on reachable V1 LOCAL paths, both verified against primary source. P0 #1 (OrderService.php:2285) was introduced TODAY by commit 1808f94946 — the very fix that closed the "changePaymentStatus escape-Z" sale-leak instead created a cross-window orphan: a UNPAID/PENDING_COUNTER order flipped PAID after its Z-window closes now ALLOCATES a real fiscal_sequence_no but lands in ZERO signed Z reports (ZReportService.aggregate windows strictly by created_at at :343-347, post-Z catch at :387-390 covers terminal-status rows only; 143/186 live orders sit in the precondition state). P0 #2 (ZReportService.php:355-402) is a separate confirmed breach: post-Z counter-entry refunds create a fresh-timestamped RETURNED mirror that is invisible to the signed total_ttc (applyOrderToTotals:632-637 reads $order->total / pos_payment_method, never order_payments — the negated payments only reach the additive cash-enrichment decorator), so every sealed-window refund overstates the signed daily Z by the full refund amount (empirical tinker repro: total_ttc=0 vs expected -55). Both files require a lock-plan + owner gate because ZReportService.php is §7 frozen and the cross-window settlement remediation is fiscal-policy-critical. Beyond the P0s, 7 deduplicated P1s remain (two fiscal-adjacent: dormant TVA/HT discount split + changePaymentStatus seq-gap concurrency), all clearly fixable but secondary to the fiscal blocker. The rest of the surface (POS, kiosk, KDS, OSS, livreur sync, money/auth/branch isolation) is sound — no money-loss, broken-surface, or auth/branch P0 was confirmed — but a numbered receipt absent from every signed Z is a categorical NF525 stop-ship that cannot pass to production.

Remediation (409 reject-late-settlement + counter-entry flow vs positive post-Z adjustment) is fiscal-critical — owner gate + regression test asserting cross-window paid-flip appears in exactly one Z. OrderService.php is NOT §7 frozen but any ZReportService adjustment variant needs a lock-plan.

app/Services/Fiscal/ZReportService.php:355-402 — Post-Z counter-entry refund mirror is invisible in the signed Z total_ttc/total_by_method (applyOrderToTotals reads $order->total, not order_payments); every sealed-window counter-entry refund overstates the signed daily Z by the full refunded amount. confirmed.title: Outbox rescue lane B re-broadcasts EVERY healthy already-dispatched event (no last_error discriminator) — violates the documented "broadcaster never fires twice" invariant and inflates the high queue lane
confirmed.recommendation: NOT frozen (OutboxRescueCommand.php is not in CLAUDE.md §7) — direct fix permissible after owner gate. Lane B needs a positive 'not yet successfully broadcast' discriminator. Cleanest: add a `broadcast_succeeded_at` column set in Phase-3a so lane B can require `broadcast_succeeded_at IS NULL` — the schema currently overloads `dispatched_at` to mean BOTH 'claimed' and 'broadcast OK', which is why success vs first-attempt-crash are indistinguishable. Minimal stop-gap (no migration): mirror MonitorOutboxStaleness H3's discriminator by adding `->whereNotNull('last_error')` to lane B's crashed-row closure — this stops re-broadcasting all healthy rows; the documented tradeoff is it misses the rare first-attempt hard-crash orphan whose last_error is NULL (that narrow case is anyway caught later by the staleness monitor pages once attempts climbs). Either way, ADD a regression test asserting `Bus::assertNotDispatched` for a `dispatched_at`-set, `last_error`-NULL, `attempts<5` row aged >10min, and FIX `test_rescue_picks_crash_claimed_row_past_threshold` to seed `last_error != NULL` so it actually represents a crash orphan rather than a healthy row.
confirmed.reasoning:
REAL defect, but P1→P2 downgrade. The structural claim is fully verified: OutboxRescueCommand.php:42-47 lane B predicate is exactly `whereNotNull('dispatched_at') AND dispatched_at < now()-10min` with outer `attempts<5` (:47) and NO last_error discriminator. A healthy successfully-broadcast row is byte-identical to this shape: DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:80-83 sets dispatched_at in Phase 1, and Phase 3a (:153-155) clears last_error to NULL while leaving dispatched_at SET. MonitorOutboxStaleness.php:68-69 comment explicitly confirms "Phase-3a clears last_error on success, so a healthy dispatched row never matches" — i.e. healthy = dispatched_at SET + last_error NULL.

EMPIRICAL REPRO (live dev DB via artisan tinker): total=417 domain_events; rescue lane B predicate matched 417/417; all 417 are healthy (last_error NULL); attempts distribution = {1:39, 2:378}, all under the <5 cap. So on the next everyMinute rescue tick (Kernel.php:40-43, confirmed scheduled everyMinute+withoutOverlapping+onOneServer) every dispatched event would be re-queued. Lane B first NULLs dispatched_at (:59-61) then re-dispatches (:64), so the new job's Phase-1 guard (:75) sees NULL → re-claims → re-broadcasts (a genuine second fire, not a silent-skip). The cited green test test_rescue_picks_crash_claimed_row_past_threshold seeds dispatched_at=15min-ago/attempts=2/last_error=NULL (healthy shape, seed helper :165) and asserts Bus::assertDispatched — PASSES (ran it), ratifying re-broadcast of a healthy-shaped row. The same-author MonitorOutboxStaleness uses 3 guards (last_error NOT NULL, attempts>=5, age :72-76) — proving the positive discriminator exists and was applied there but omitted in rescue lane B. The recommended stop-gap (mirror H3's whereNotNull('last_error')) is sound.

WHY P2 NOT P1: severity hinges on the SINK, which I checked. Every OrderCreated Echo handler is idempotent: OSS this.list() (PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:283), KDS _debouncedRefresh (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1912), POS tracker fetchOrders (PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:692), Kiosk waiting ID-matched queueNumber assignment (KioskWaitingComponent.vue:278-280). All re-fetch authoritative server state or set the same value — NONE append/double-count/create duplicate tickets. So duplicate broadcasts cause redundant refetches + ~4× transient high-lane queue inflation per event (self-capped by attempts<5) + a possible brief false staleCount flicker between rescue null-out and re-claim — degraded efficiency/robustness, NOT data corruption, fiscal/NF525, money, auth/branch, or a broken surface. The claim's "violates broadcaster-never-fires-twice invariant" framing OVERSTATES: DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:54-58 scopes that invariant to concurrent-worker races (lockForUpdate guard), not a global exactly-once guarantee, and the code itself documents the rescue re-broadcast as "one extra broadcast (visible re-render, no fiscal corruption — broadcasts are advisory)." Reachable in V1 LOCAL (rescue is scheduled, single-box), file not in CLAUDE.md §7 frozen list, fixable after owner gate. Real, worth fixing, but P2.

confirmed.title: Consumer correlation-dedup drops 2nd..Nth ItemAvailabilityChanged of one request — multi-item auto-86 silently keeps depleted items sellable on POS/Kiosk
confirmed.recommendation: Include aggregate_id/item_id in the consumer dedup key for per-aggregate event types. In resources/js/services/eventContract.js correlationDedupeKey(), add the per-event discriminator (payload aggregate_id/item_id) for ItemAvailabilityChanged so events 2..N of the same request are no longer collapsed; pass parsed.payload.item_id through onEvents() rawHandler into isDuplicateCorrelation(). Mirror the backend idempotency_key which DOES include item_id (PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:62-69) — the contract intent is per-(item,branch) uniqueness but the consumer dedup is coarser. eventContract.js is NOT in CLAUDE.md §7 frozen list, so a direct fix is allowed.
confirmed.reasoning:
VERIFIED REAL — all five claimed links confirmed by Read, plus two extra checks that strengthen (not weaken) the finding.

(1) Consumer dedup key is coarse: correlationDedupeKey() (eventContract.js:264-272) = `eventType:branch:correlationId` — item_id/aggregate_id is NOT in the key. onEvents() rawHandler calls isDuplicateCorrelation(parsed.correlationId, parsed.type, parsed.branchId) and returns early on first match (eventContract.js:363-365), BEFORE handler(parsed). parseEvent (line 59-73) shows `type` and `branchId` come from the envelope and are identical for every ItemAvailabilityChanged of one branch; only aggregate_id/payload.item_id differ — exactly the discriminators the key ignores.

(2) Shared correlation_id confirmed: CorrelationIdMiddleware (lines 14-21) sets ONE request-stable id via Log::withContext. PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox::resolveCorrelationId (lines 121-137) reads that shared value. The event uses DispatchableAfterCommit (ItemAvailabilityChanged.php:23) and the listener is NOT ShouldQueue, so it runs synchronously in-process after commit — Log::sharedContext()/request() still hold the same id. EventContract::buildEnvelope (EventContract.php:81-90) propagates correlation_id into the broadcast envelope.

(3) Backend creates DISTINCT rows per item (idempotency_key includes item_id, lines 62-69) — so the collapse is purely consumer-side, as claimed.

(4) Multi-event emission path real: StockService::decrementForOrder loops requirements and collects one ItemAvailabilityChanged per depleted item, then dispatches each (StockService.php:140-159, dispatchAvailabilityChanged 149-160), invoked from DecrementStockOnOrderCreated:35 within the OrderCreated request.

(5) Handlers are per-item incremental on BOTH affected surfaces — PosComponent _onItemAvailabilityChanged (2857-2914) reads payload.item_id, marks only that item, prunes only that item's cart lines; KioskAppComponent subscribes the same way (546-550). No full refetch inside the handler.

SEVERITY = P1 (not P0, not P2):
- Not P0: pricing stays backend-SSOT, NF525 chain untouched, money correct, surface not broken. It's an oversell of a depleted item.
- Not P2 (bounded-staleness): I checked the out-of-band refetch. The regular POS poll (_startKioskPolling tick, PosComponent 2748-2762) refreshes only orders (loadKioskCashOrders/loadActiveOrdersStats/loadReadyOrders) — it does NOT call itemList(). The only catalogue refetch fallback is PosSyncService, which (a) only polls while WS is DISCONNECTED (_shouldPollForState true only when not connected; suspends on 'connected', lines 180-183/405-411) and (b) defaults disabled (runtimeConfig.enabled requires explicit true, line 150). In the normal CONNECTED-WS case — precisely when these events ARE delivered over Echo and dropped by dedup — there is NO bounded availability refetch. Items 2..N stay sellable until WS reconnect (_onWsConnected→itemList, 2710), branch change, a type:'full' admin event, or manual reload. Unbounded staleness. PosSyncService.js:51 even names this exact bug class ("POS shows stale stock; items 86'd at KDS still sellable").

REACHABILITY: auto-86-by-stock is a documented V1 feature (CLAUDE.md §6 /admin/stock-rupture-dashboard; AvailabilityService). Dev DB has 0 stock_levels rows (artisan tinker: stock_levels=0, item-type on_hand>0 = 0), so the path is DORMANT-IN-DEV (cannot reproduce live, which is why the auditor's GROUP BY returned 0 — honestly disclosed) but not unreachable in V1: an owner who enables per-item stock tracking and whose single order depletes 2+ tracked items to zero triggers it.

Confidence 7 (not higher) because the trigger is conjunctive (stock tracking enabled AND ≥2 items co-deplete in one order) and unobservable on the current seed — code-trace certain, live-repro impossible here. The recommended fix (add item_id to the consumer dedup discriminator for per-aggregate event types, mirroring the backend idempotency_key) is correct and eventContract.js is NOT in §7 frozen, so a direct fix is permissible.

confirmed.title: Admin dashboard "Retry failed" button reintroduces a documented-P0 anti-pattern: wipes attempts→0 + last_error→NULL, orphaning chronically-failing outbox rows from the prune lane and destroying forensic trail
confirmed.recommendation: Make the HTTP path match the healed CLI command (OutboxRetryFailedCommand.php:102-156): preserve `attempts` monotonically (only re-null `dispatched_at`), preserve `last_error`, bound the query by `->where('attempts','<', OutboxRetryFailedCommand::REPLAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS)`, and ideally write an AuditLogService row per replay + hold the same Cache::lock. Simplest scope-minimal fix: change lines 384-396 to reuse the CLI command's lane (or call `Artisan::call('foodking:outbox:retry-failed')`) instead of the divergent inline forceFill. Also extend OutboxRetryFailedAttemptsPreservedTest to cover this controller action so the ratchet catches the HTTP path (currently it asserts only against the CLI command — tests/Feature/Outbox/OutboxRetryFailedAttemptsPreservedTest.php:48-120). Not a frozen file — direct edit permitted.
confirmed.reasoning: CONFIRMED REAL on a reachable V1 LOCAL path. Read SyncOverviewController.php:377-406: outboxRetryFailed() query (384-389) = whereNull('dispatched_at')->whereNotNull('last_error') with NO upper attempts bound, then forceFill(['attempts'=>0,'last_error'=>null])->save() at 393-396. This is the exact pre-heal anti-pattern. The canonical CLI command (OutboxRetryFailedCommand.php) was healed on 2026-05-19 (commit 7db47f022, Z3 B-2 P0): it only re-nulls dispatched_at (154-156), preserves attempts monotonically + last_error, bounds the lane via ->failed(5)->where('attempts','<',12)->where('created_at','>=',$cutoff) (102-108), holds Cache::lock (71), and writes an AuditLogService row per replay (121-135). The HTTP controller path does NONE of these. Orphaning is real: PruneOutboxCommand reclaims attempts>=6 AND created_at<cutoff (lines 56-57); a chronic-fail row reset to attempts=0 by the HTTP path can never reach the prune threshold and loses its forensic last_error each click. Reachability CONFIRMED end-to-end: route POST /api/admin/observability/outbox/retry-failed (routes/api.php:1176), gated role:Admin|Tenant Admin (controller __construct:52-56) + throttle:10,1, wired to a real UI button (OutboxOverviewComponent.vue:61-65 data-testid=outbox-retry-failed -> retryFailed() line 373 -> axios.post line 376); Admin role exists in V1 (admin@lecayenne.fr). Test ratchet gap CONFIRMED: OutboxRetryFailedAttemptsPreservedTest (48-124) exercises only Artisan::call(foodking:outbox:retry-failed), never the controller action, so the HTTP variant is unguarded. File is NOT in the §7 FROZEN list — direct edit permitted. Downgraded P0->P1: domain_events is sync/broadcast plumbing (not NF525 fiscal/audit data — controller comment and code confirm fiscal tables untouched), no money/auth/branch breakage, and the orphaned row still pages the operator via the staleness monitor (filters dispatched_at NULL). It is wrong behavior on a real clickable path + missing critical state (audit trail + monotonic attempts) + divergence from the explicitly-healed canonical lane + a coverage gap — a solid P1.

confirmed.title: Cross-Z-window UNPAID→PAID settlement allocates a fiscal_sequence_no but lands the PAID sale in ZERO signed Z reports (NF525 gap-free invariant breakage)
confirmed.recommendation: Add a sealed/closed-Z-window membership guard on the PAID transition in OrderService::changePaymentStatus, symmetric to the existing REFUNDED SealedOrderGuard at line 2231: before allocating the sequence at 2285, detect whether the order's created_at falls before the current open Z's opened_at (i.e. a since-closed window) and either (a) reject the late settlement with a 409 directing the operator to a counter-entry/adjustment flow, or (b) record it as a positive post-Z adjustment in the current window's aggregate (extend ZReportService.php:384-402 to capture positive cross-window settlements keyed on the PAID transition's updated_at, mirroring the negative-adjustment logic). OrderService.php is NOT in the §7 frozen list, so this is a direct (non-frozen) fix — but it is NF525-fiscal-critical, so gate the chosen policy on owner sign-off + a regression test (cross-window paid-flip must appear in exactly one Z) before shipping. Do NOT touch the frozen ZReportService/FiscalSequenceService logic; the post-Z adjustment extension, if chosen, is a logic change there and would itself require a lock-plan + owner gate.
confirmed.reasoning:
VERIFIED REAL — NF525 gap-free / "every fiscally-sequenced receipt in exactly one Z" breakage on a reachable V1 LOCAL path, introduced by today's commit 1808f94946 (2026-05-29 13:53, blame-confirmed on lines 2285-2289).

Code trace, all read-confirmed:
1. OrderService.php:2285-2289 — inside the changePaymentStatus write txn, on ANY transition where target==PAID && fiscal_sequence_no===null, it calls FiscalSequenceService::next() to allocate a sequence. Matches the claim verbatim.
2. The only sealed-window guard upstream (OrderService.php:2231, SealedOrderGuard::assertMutable) fires for REFUNDED ONLY. The PAID transition has no sealed-window check.
3. PaymentStateMachine.php:10-16 explicitly ALLOWS UNPAID->PAID and PENDING_COUNTER->PAID, so assertCanTransition (line 2258) does not block the flip.
4. ZReportService::aggregate windows STRICTLY by created_at: line 343-347 (created_at <= $to, and if $from then created_at > $from where $from = currentOpenZ->opened_at). Line 340-341 base query: whereNotNull(fiscal_sequence_no) AND payment_status != UNPAID.
5. The post-Z adjustment path (ZReportService.php:384-402) catches ONLY negative terminal-status rows (CANCELED/REJECTED/RETURNED, applied -1). There is NO positive UNPAID->PAID cross-window catch. Confirmed by Read.

Reachability: route online-order/change-payment-status/{order} (api.php:983, auth:sanctum + verify.api group) -> OnlineOrderController::changePaymentStatus (Admin/OnlineOrderController.php:103) delegates directly to OrderService::changePaymentStatus. PosOrderController + AdminTableOrderController share the same service method.

Triggering-state EMPIRICALLY confirmed via artisan tinker against the live DB: 84 UNPAID delivery/takeaway (order_type 5/10) orders with null fiscal_sequence_no, plus 59 PENDING_COUNTER null-sequence orders — 143 of 186 total orders sit in the precondition state right now. A COD delivery/takeaway order left UNPAID at evening Z-close (excluded by line 340 null-seq + line 341 UNPAID), then flipped PAID next morning, gets a sequence at line 2287 but: created_at (yesterday) < this-morning's Z opened_at, so it FAILS created_at > $from and is excluded from the current Z; the previous closed Z already excluded it. Net: a PAID sale carrying a fiscal_sequence_no that appears in ZERO signed Z reports.

No compensating control exists: RetryFiscalAllocCommand (lines 66-68) targets payment_status=PAID AND fiscal_sequence_no IS NULL only — cannot catch a numbered orphan. warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders (ZReportService.php:586-597) ALSO windows by created_at (593-597) AND keys on whereNull(fiscal_sequence_no) — catches neither the cross-window case nor a numbered row. Grep found no Z-membership reconciliation for numbered-but-unwindowed orders.

Sentinel gap confirmed: FiscalSealedZSentinelTest.php:74-78 asserts the sealed guard is wired for 'changePaymentStatus -> REFUNDED' only; no test covers a cross-window UNPAID->PAID flip's Z membership.

Correction to the auditor's "aggravator" (kept honest): the claim "pre-fix it would have been caught by warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders" is FALSE for the cross-window case, because that warning also windows by created_at — it only catches same-window late-paid orders. The genuinely-new violation today's commit introduced: pre-fix this was a lost sale with NULL sequence (no number consumed); post-fix it allocates a real fiscal_sequence_no with no Z home — a numbered receipt absent from every signed Z. That is the NF525 breakage.

Severity P0 (fiscal/NF525 breakage). OrderService.php is NOT in the §7 frozen list, so a direct fix is permissible, but the remediation policy (reject late cross-window settlement with 409 + counter-entry flow, vs. positive post-Z adjustment) is fiscal-critical and must gate on owner sign-off + a regression test (cross-window paid-flip must appear in exactly one Z). Do NOT touch the frozen ZReportService/FiscalSequenceService for the adjustment variant without a lock-plan.

Confidence 9 not 10: the live-fire reproduction (actually flipping one of the 84 rows post-Z-close and re-aggregating) was not executed read-only; the conclusion rests on a fully grounded static code trace + the empirical precondition count, which is decisive.

confirmed.title: NF525 Z-report TVA/HT split is wrong on any discounted order (discount absorbed entirely into HT, TVA stays computed on pre-discount base) — dormant today only because all V1 items are 0% VAT
confirmed.recommendation: lock-plan + owner gate. The TVA figure originates from a FROZEN file (ZReportService.php:634 reads $order->total_tax) so this is not a direct edit. Surgical fix: introduce a non-frozen Order::getTotalTvaAttribute that prorates total_tax by the discount ratio (or derives TVA per tax_rate from the discounted TTC) so total_tva reflects VAT actually owed on the collected amount, then point ZReportService::applyOrderToTotals at that accessor (the line 634 change to read $order->total_tva instead of $order->total_tax touches the frozen ZReportService — requires LOCK_<id>.md + owner countersign). Add a regression test extending OrderTotalHtDecompositionTest to cover a discounted VAT-bearing order asserting total_tva == round(total - total/(1+rate/100),2). LOW operational urgency for the current 0%-VAT dataset; MUST be fixed before any non-zero VAT rate is configured on items, otherwise every discounted receipt seals an over-declared VAT into the immutable Z chain.
confirmed.reasoning:
VERIFIED REAL as a latent NF525-correctness defect, but currently DORMANT (not active on any V1 order today). Every cited line says what's claimed:

(1) PricingService.php:317 `$totalTax += $taxPrice` accumulates per-line tax INSIDE the item loop, BEFORE the discount is computed (331-344) and applied (351 tax-inclusive: `$rawTotal = $realSubtotal + $delivery - $calculatedDiscount`). The discount never touches tax. Confirmed by Read.
(2) `total_tax` is persisted from the pre-discount `$pricing->totalTax` (OrderQuoteService.php:94), while `total` = post-discount finalTotal.
(3) No `total_ht` column exists (Schema::hasColumn returned false), so ZReportService.php:633 uses the Order::getTotalHtAttribute accessor = `total - total_tax` (Order.php:115), and line 634 sums raw pre-discount `$order->total_tax` for total_tva. The per-rate breakdown (line 652) sums order_items.tax_amount = same pre-discount base. No compensating recomputation exists in the Z path.
(4) Reproduced the math exactly in tinker: 11.50 TTC @ VAT10% inclusive, 4.00 discount -> stored total_tax=1.05, total=7.50; Z split HT=6.45/TVA=1.05/TTC=7.50 (identity holds) but legally-correct TVA on 7.50 collected = round(7.5 - 7.5/1.10,2)=0.68 -> TVA OVERSTATED by 0.37, discount dumped entirely into HT. Matches the claim precisely.
(5) The lock test OrderTotalHtDecompositionTest.php only asserts no-discount cases (total=12.50/tax=2.50 and total=7.00/tax=0) — the discounted VAT split is genuinely uncovered. Confirmed by Read.
(6) All three discount paths are real: POS manual (PricingService.php:339, context pos/table), coupon (332-338), kiosk loyalty.

DECISIVE MASKING (auditor was honest and I independently confirmed): `Item::selectRaw('tax_id,count(*)')->groupBy()` returns 42 items tax_id=NULL + 3 items tax_id=1; taxes table id=1 is 'No-VAT' rate=0.000000. NO item uses tax_id 2/3/4/5 (the non-zero rates). With taxRate=0, taxPrice=0 always -> total_tax=0 -> HT=TTC -> NO split error is observable on ANY current order. PRICING_TAX_INCLUSIVE=true is set, matching the repro premise. So the ACTIVE exploit path is unreachable in V1 today — it activates only when a non-zero VAT rate (e.g. food 10%, tax_id=3 already seeded) is assigned to an item, a config/data change that has not occurred.

Severity kept at P1 (not rejected, not downgraded to P2): this is a verified fiscal-correctness defect that, once VAT is configured, seals an over-declared TVA into the immutable 6-year HMAC Z-chain — a high-stakes NF525 consequence one config flip away. It is not a style issue and not SaaS-only. But it is explicitly DORMANT, not an active V1-LOCAL bug today; recommendation correctly routes through lock-plan + owner gate since the fix touches FROZEN ZReportService.php:634 (introduce non-frozen Order::getTotalTvaAttribute prorating tax by the discount ratio / deriving per-rate TVA from discounted TTC, then point line 634 at it; extend the test to a discounted VAT-bearing order). Confidence 8: mechanics and dormancy both empirically proven; the only judgment call is severity labeling of a latent-but-fiscal defect.

confirmed.title: Post-Z counter-entry refund mirror is INVISIBLE in the signed Z total_ttc — day revenue overstated by full refund amount (NF525 breach)
confirmed.recommendation: lock-plan + owner gate (ZReportService.php is CLAUDE.md §7 frozen). Do NOT direct-edit. The signed Z TTC must net the post-Z counter-entry refund. Option A (preferred, aggregate-side): in aggregate(), include current-window RETURNED orders that carry parent_order_id (i.e. counter-entry mirrors) in applyOrderToTotals with sign +1 (their total is already negated), distinct from the existing terminal-status exclusion which must stay for pre-Z voids. Option B (mirror-side, no frozen touch): give the mirror a dedicated non-terminal status/marker so it flows through the positive loop with its negative total while staying excluded from operational KDS/terminal filters. Either way add a regression test: open Z, create counter-entry mirror, close Z, assert total_ttc and total_by_method reflect the negative. Until fixed, every sealed (post-Z) refund silently inflates the signed, 6-year-archived Z report by the refunded amount.
confirmed.reasoning:
CONFIRMED REAL via primary-source code + end-to-end empirical reproduction driving the actual RefundWithCounterEntryService and ZReportService::aggregate.

Code trace (all read directly):
- ZReportService.php:349-357 — positive loop does whereNotIn('status', [CANCELED,REJECTED,RETURNED]); the mirror has status=RETURNED → excluded. Correct.
- ZReportService.php:387-390 — post-Z negative-adjustment query requires created_at<=$from AND updated_at>$from AND status=RETURNED. The service-created mirror has created_at=now() (in the CURRENT window, > $from) → fails the created_at<=$from predicate → excluded. The parent (created_at<=$from) is NOT transitioned to RETURNED (it stays DELIVERED, updated_at not bumped) → also excluded. So neither row contributes the -55.
